result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with nothing left, so the WH-1 example shows only "Bolt 10". The quantity lookup for nuts still returns 0.

- **Fix:** in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, `listStockByWarehouse` now filters with `s.quantity > 0`. This is the same filter the per-category and per-category-and-warehouse overviews already use.
- **Test:** I added `warehouseStockLeavesOutProductsWithNothingLeft` to `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockOverviewTest.java`. It takes all nuts out, sets screws to 0, and checks the stock list and the nut quantity.

`mvn -o` ran `StockOverviewTest` and `StockTest` with no failures. Nothing is committed.
